reviewer_notes: All four claims share one defect: the items ask for the right moves, and K1's own wording even names the no-outside-aid condition explicitly, but the declared administration (unsupervised, at home, with AI, internet, and a CAS all permitted) means no response can be attributed to the student doing it unaided. Worth flagging on its own: the assessment's printed header directly contradicts how it is actually administered. A short (2-4 minute) supervised check per claim, using the same primitive already implied or used by each claim, recovers the missing independent evidence at low cost; K4's own item is already a short Generate task, so its supervised version costs nothing beyond moving it into class.
